surface: The grid as one tab stop (tabNavigation: false): Tab leaves the grid from any cell, Shift+Tab returns to the cell it left, and the arrows still move inside.

steps.note: With tabNavigation off, Tab from a cell in the middle of the grid leaves it for the page's next control.
Shift+Tab from the page returns into the grid on the cell it left.
The arrows still move between cells.
Shift+Tab leaves the grid for the page's previous control, whichever cell has the focus.
Tab from the page returns into the grid on the cell it left.
